statement: For every connected simple graph G on exactly eight vertices and every integer d >= 1, (Psi_G|degree d)^2 - (Psi_G|degree d-1)(Psi_G|degree d+1) is Schur-positive. More precisely, for d=1,...,7 every Schur coefficient is a positive integer (the minimum over all graphs, degrees, and partitions is 1), while for d>=8 the expression is zero.
contribution: This exact exhaustive computation completes the eight-vertex layer of Conjecture 7.3, one layer beyond the source's reported verification through seven vertices. It covers all 11,117 connected isomorphism classes and all seven relevant degrees using integer symmetric-function arithmetic, with the 1,614 chordal and 9,503 nonchordal classes reported separately; this is a candidate computational resolution pending fresh audit, not a priority claim beyond the bounded source comparison recorded in problem.md.
